steps.body: Counting out reverses the game: instead of asking how many, you remove exactly the number asked for — and STOP when the count says so.

predict.prompt: Counting out 7 from a pile of many — when do you stop?
predict.reveal: The request fixes the stopping point; the rest of the pile is not your problem.

cml.actionGoal: Pair each object with exactly one number and trust the last number said for kch count out.
invariants: A count pairs objects with number words one to one, and its last word names the whole group — which is why order, spacing, and arrangement can change without changing the answer for kch count out.
misconceptions: Skipping or double-counting an object, recounting when nothing changed, or believing a spread-out group holds more.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one more object joined the group, what would the last counting word become?
